lines.t: There's a road that runs straight through the pain
Where every scar is counted, every tear is named
A soul persists through the bitterest rain
Each burdened shoulder, every loss retained
This is the journey for the ones who strive
Heart set steady just to finish the ride
Every step is taken
Even love forsaken
To be counted among the ones who persevere
The deeper thunders waking
A higher voice overtaking
A gentle whisper through the ache and through the years
Endure, endure through the night and fire
Brave the storm, remember what you fight for
But in surrender, surrender
It's love that lifts you higher
Letting go, you'll rise above on eagle's wings
Forever
Some are broken by the weight inside
side. Haunted by regrets they could not hide. Yet every moment clinging on to pride brings a heart
no closer to the holy side. So the fighter presses on bruise and bleed, but the lover set free with
a single need. Let it fall, let it break. Trust the shepherd when he calls your name. For only in
Your ruins can life awake
When nothing's left but what He gives and takes
Endure, endure, hold the line
Survive, noble are the men who never cease to strive
But in surrender, surrender
It's there you come alive
The greatest love, new breath to breathe
To fly on eagle's wings
Are you undone, when apart from Him
Does your soul burn, longing just for love again
All the striving, all the crying
Let it end, let the fire consume
Be destroyed in love, let the tears be gold
This is not defeat, but the breaking of the mold
You were made for glory greater than survives
You were born to soar, to truly come alive
Every hero's tale is shadows and light
Most never see what lies beyond the fight
But those who yield surrendering the night
I will see the sun rise and take to flight
Endure, endure, brave the pain until the dawn
Bless the man whose strength can press on
But in surrender, surrender, freedom's song
His power made perfect when you're gone
So endure, endure, let hope remain
There's purpose in the rain
But only wonder, only love sustains
For those who lose themselves in Him
Will rise on eagles' wings
Let go of everything
Let your heart be undone
Let the grip of pain give way to the sun
For when the struggle ends
And surrender begins
You will find yourself
Flying
On eagle's wings
Thanks for watching!
